Is this abuse?

Of 6,911 pass holders, 4,065 (59%) have reordered; 2,614 only once. By the flag rule, 180 customers exceeded 24 free bags in a 30-day window (a 3rd+ bundle). Of the non-active reorderers, most are explained (refunded passes or promo/sweepstakes); only 6 have no pass on record at all — the ones still worth investigating.
Flagged rule
180 customers ordered more than 24 free bags (a 3rd+ bag bundle) within a rolling 30-day window. 12–24 bags per 30 days is treated as normal — including one extra bundle to cover a premature bag-fill issue. The "Peak 30d" column shows each customer's busiest 30-day total.
